subject: Programming and DS: Data Structures
name: Binary Tree
priorityEvidence: 53 PYQs extracted — highest-PYQ topic in all of Data Structures, tested almost every year 1987-2025. Fourth topic in study order, builds on Linked List's pointer model.

prerequisites.why: Tree nodes generalize linked-list nodes to multiple (left/right) pointers.

unlocks.why: BST is a Binary Tree with an ordering invariant — direct extension.
Heap is a complete binary tree with a different invariant — reuses the array-representation pattern.
B-Trees generalize binary tree indexing ideas used in database indexes.
